# Copilot instructions

Follow every instruction in `AGENTS.md` at the repository root.

This is a beginner vanilla HTML/CSS business card project. Students work only inside the two cards: `style-box-model.css` uses the box model only (no flexbox or grid), `style-flex.css` uses flexbox and/or grid. Do not change `template.css` or the page structure, and do not write JavaScript or use CSS libraries. Coach the student instead of designing their cards.

Every generated or substantially rewritten code or content region must be wrapped in AI citation comments containing the student's prompt, and every such interaction must also be logged under "AI Use" in `citations.html`. Never remove existing citations.
